```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=F,include=F}
draw_diag <- function(){
  lines(c(10^(-10),10^10),c(10^(-10),10^10), col= alpha('#A6A6A6',0.75), lwd = 1.5)
}
new_diag <- function(usr, col = '#A6A6A6') {
  lims <- c(max(usr[1], usr[3]), min(usr[2], usr[4]))
  
  segments(
    lims[1], lims[1],
    lims[2], lims[2],
    lwd = 1.5,
    col = alpha(col, 0.75),
    lty = 5
  )
}
```

```{r,  eval=T,fig.width=3.1, fig.height=3.,  echo=F,dpi=300, warning=F, results='show'}
hepG2_plot_hnf4a_conc <- 26.53009141
```

```{r,  eval=T,fig.width=2.6, fig.height=3.2,  echo=F,dpi=300, warning=F, results='show'}
#par(bg=NA)
fc_scatter_ticks <- c(1,5,25,125)
plot_fc_comparison <- function(x,y,xlab,ylab,point_col,
                               axis_ticks=fc_scatter_ticks,xlim,ylim) {
  keep <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y) & x > 0 & y > 0
  x <- x[keep]
  y <- y[keep]
  plot_lims <- range(c(x,y,axis_ticks))
  plot(x,y,log="xy",type="n",axes=FALSE,ann=FALSE,
       xlim=xlim,ylim=ylim)
  new_diag(10^(par("usr")))
  points(x,y,pch=21,cex=0.65,lwd=0.35,
         col=alpha("black",0.30),bg=alpha(point_col,0.50))
  axis(1,at=axis_ticks,labels=axis_ticks,lwd=1,tck=-0.02,
       col=rgb(0,0,0,0),col.ticks="black",padj=-2,cex.axis=0.8)
  axis(2,at=axis_ticks,labels=axis_ticks,lwd=1,tck=-0.02,
       col=rgb(0,0,0,0),col.ticks="black",padj=1.5,cex.axis=0.8)
  title(xlab=xlab,ylab=ylab,line=1.5,cex.lab=1)
  box()
}

plot_fc_comparison(k1f_fc$fc,k3h_fc$fc,
                   "FOXA1","HNF4A","#6B6B6B",
                   axis_ticks=c(1,5,25),xlim=c(0.6,26),ylim=c(0.6,26))
plot_fc_comparison(k1f_fc$fc,k4fh_fc$fc,
                   "FOXA1","FOXA1&HNF4A","#E86F77",xlim=c(0.6,26),ylim=c(0.6,280))
plot_fc_comparison(k3h_fc$fc,k4fh_fc$fc,
                   "HNF4A","FOXA1&HNF4A","#4192D9",xlim=c(0.6,26),ylim=c(0.6,280))
```

### predicted activity over basal

```{r,  eval=T, echo=F, warning=F, results='hide'}
predict_activity_over_basal <- function(conc, par_table) {
  range_x <- exp(c(seq(log(min(conc)/1.), log(max(conc*1.)), length.out=300)))
  predicted_activity <- t(sapply(row.names(par_table), function(seq_id) {
    par_here <- list(basal=par_table[seq_id,]$basal,
                     Fmax=par_table[seq_id,]$Fmax,
                     Kd=par_table[seq_id,]$Kd,
                     n=par_table[seq_id,]$n)
    hill_equation(par_here, range_x)
  }))
  colnames(predicted_activity) <- paste0("c", seq_along(range_x), "_", signif(range_x, 4))
  
  log2_activity_over_basal <- log2(predicted_activity/par_table[row.names(predicted_activity),]$basal)
  colnames(log2_activity_over_basal) <- colnames(predicted_activity)
  
  list(conc=range_x,
       activity=predicted_activity,
       log2_activity_over_basal=log2_activity_over_basal)
}

k1f_predicted <- predict_activity_over_basal(conc_foxa1, gHill_par_foxa1_k1f)
k3h_predicted <- predict_activity_over_basal(conc_hnf4a_alone, gHill_par_foxa1_k3h)
k4fh_predicted <- predict_activity_over_basal(fxh_con, gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh_old)

k1f_log2_activity_over_basal <- k1f_predicted$log2_activity_over_basal
k3h_log2_activity_over_basal <- k3h_predicted$log2_activity_over_basal
k4fh_log2_activity_over_basal <- k4fh_predicted$log2_activity_over_basal

k1f_activity_over_basal_conc <- k1f_predicted$conc
k3h_activity_over_basal_conc <- k3h_predicted$conc
k4fh_activity_over_basal_conc <- k4fh_predicted$conc
```

```{r,  eval=T,fig.width=3.2, fig.height=4,  echo=F, warning=F, results='hide',dpi=300}
predict_log2_activity_over_basal_at <- function(conc, par_table) {
  predicted_activity <- t(sapply(row.names(par_table), function(seq_id) {
    par_here <- list(basal=par_table[seq_id,]$basal,
                     Fmax=par_table[seq_id,]$Fmax,
                     Kd=par_table[seq_id,]$Kd,
                     n=par_table[seq_id,]$n)
    hill_equation(par_here, conc)
  }))
  colnames(predicted_activity) <- paste0("c", seq_along(conc), "_", signif(conc, 4))
  log2(predicted_activity/par_table[row.names(predicted_activity),]$basal)
}

predict_log2_activity_scalar <- function(conc, par_table, seq_id) {
  par_here <- list(
    basal=par_table[seq_id,]$basal,
    Fmax=par_table[seq_id,]$Fmax,
    Kd=par_table[seq_id,]$Kd,
    n=par_table[seq_id,]$n
  )
  log2(hill_equation(par_here, conc)/par_here$basal)
}

    gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh_old,
    seq_id
  ) -
    (predict_log2_activity_scalar(
      hepG2_foxa1_conc,
      gHill_par_foxa1_k1f,
      seq_id
    ) + predict_log2_activity_scalar(
      hepG2_hnf4a_conc,
      gHill_par_foxa1_k3h,
      seq_id
    ))
}), common_seq)

finite_synergy <- is.finite(synergy_for_diag)
synergy_scaled <- rep(NA_real_, length(synergy_for_diag))
min_negative_synergy <- min(c(0, synergy_for_diag[finite_synergy]))
max_positive_synergy <- max(c(0, synergy_for_diag[finite_synergy]))

# Give the negative range 1/7 the visual span of the positive range:
# negative occupies 1/8 of the bar and positive occupies the remaining 7/8.
synergy_zero_position <- 1/8
synergy_scaled[finite_synergy] <- synergy_zero_position

negative_synergy <- finite_synergy & synergy_for_diag < 0
if (min_negative_synergy < 0) {
  synergy_scaled[negative_synergy] <-
    synergy_zero_position *
    (synergy_for_diag[negative_synergy] - min_negative_synergy) /
    -min_negative_synergy
}

positive_synergy <- finite_synergy & synergy_for_diag > 0
if (max_positive_synergy > 0) {
  synergy_scaled[positive_synergy] <-
    synergy_zero_position + (1 - synergy_zero_position) *
    synergy_for_diag[positive_synergy] / max_positive_synergy
}

         xout = synergy_palette_positions)$y,

         xout = synergy_palette_positions)$y,
  approx(c(0, synergy_zero_position, 1), synergy_anchor_rgb[3, ],
         xout = synergy_palette_positions)$y,
  maxColorValue = 255
)
synergy_col_index <- pmax(1, pmin(101, round(synergy_scaled*100)+1))
synergy_line_col <- setNames(synergy_palette[synergy_col_index], common_seq)
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3.5, fig.height=4.25,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show'}
predict_log2_activity_over_basal_one <- function(conc, par_table, seq_id) {
  par_here <- list(basal=par_table[seq_id,]$basal,
                   Fmax=par_table[seq_id,]$Fmax,
                   Kd=par_table[seq_id,]$Kd,
                   n=par_table[seq_id,]$n)
  log2(hill_equation(par_here, conc)/par_here$basal)
}

diag_conc_from_fh <- function(fh_conc) {
  f_conc <- sqrt(fh_conc/fh_diag_ratio)
  h_conc <- fh_diag_ratio*f_conc
  data.frame(f_conc=f_conc, h_conc=h_conc, fh_conc=fh_conc)
}

dual_over_single_log2_at_fh <- function(fh_conc, seq_id) {
  diag_conc <- diag_conc_from_fh(fh_conc)
  predict_log2_activity_over_basal_one(diag_conc$fh_conc, gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh_old, seq_id) -
    (predict_log2_activity_over_basal_one(diag_conc$f_conc, gHill_par_foxa1_k1f, seq_id) +
       predict_log2_activity_over_basal_one(diag_conc$h_conc, gHill_par_foxa1_k3h, seq_id))
}

dual_over_single_log2_at_f_h <- function(f_conc, h_conc, seq_id) {
  predict_log2_activity_over_basal_one(f_conc*h_conc, gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh_old, seq_id) -
    (predict_log2_activity_over_basal_one(f_conc, gHill_par_foxa1_k1f, seq_id) +
       predict_log2_activity_over_basal_one(h_conc, gHill_par_foxa1_k3h, seq_id))
}

find_real_max_dual_over_single <- function(seq_id) {
  log_fh_range <- log(fh_conc_peak_range)
  opt <- optimize(function(log_fh) {
    -dual_over_single_log2_at_fh(exp(log_fh), seq_id)
  }, interval=log_fh_range)
  finite_fh <- exp(opt$minimum)
  finite_value <- -opt$objective
  low_range_value <- dual_over_single_log2_at_fh(exp(log_fh_range[1]), seq_id)
  high_range_value <- dual_over_single_log2_at_fh(exp(log_fh_range[2]), seq_id)
  edge_tolerance <- 1e-4
  if (high_range_value >= finite_value - edge_tolerance &&
      high_range_value >= low_range_value) {
    return(data.frame(max_dual_over_single=gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[seq_id,]$synergy,
                      f_conc_at_max=Inf,
                      h_conc_at_max=Inf,
                      fh_conc_at_max=Inf,
                      max_location="monotonic_increasing"))
  }
  if (low_range_value >= finite_value - edge_tolerance &&
      low_range_value >= high_range_value) {
    return(data.frame(max_dual_over_single=0,
                      f_conc_at_max=0,
                      h_conc_at_max=0,
                      fh_conc_at_max=0,
                      max_location="monotonic_decreasing"))
  }
  low_value <- 0
  high_value <- gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[seq_id,]$synergy
  max_value <- max(c(low_value, high_value, finite_value), na.rm=TRUE)
  if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_value, high_value, tolerance=1e-6))) {
    return(data.frame(max_dual_over_single=high_value,
                      f_conc_at_max=Inf,
                      h_conc_at_max=Inf,
                      fh_conc_at_max=Inf,
                      max_location="monotonic_increasing"))
  }
  if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_value, low_value, tolerance=1e-6))) {
    return(data.frame(max_dual_over_single=low_value,
                      f_conc_at_max=0,
                      h_conc_at_max=0,
                      fh_conc_at_max=0,
                      max_location="monotonic_decreasing"))
  }
  diag_conc <- diag_conc_from_fh(finite_fh)
  data.frame(max_dual_over_single=finite_value,
             f_conc_at_max=diag_conc$f_conc,
             h_conc_at_max=diag_conc$h_conc,
             fh_conc_at_max=diag_conc$fh_conc,
             max_location="finite_peak")
}

k4fh_over_single_max_conc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(common_seq, find_real_max_dual_over_single))
```

```{r, eval=T, fig.width=3.2, fig.height=3, echo=F, warning=F, results='show', dpi=300}
missing_synergy_percent_seq <- setdiff(

  synergy_percent_seq, , drop=FALSE

synergy_band_cols <- c(
  positive=alpha(synergy_fill_col,0.9),
  no_synergy="gray",
  negative="#F4E1A1"
)

calculate_synergy_percent_by_conc <- function(synergy_matrix, cutoff) {
  data.frame(
    f_conc=f_conc_diag,
    h_conc=h_conc_diag,
    fh_conc=fh_conc_diag,
    positive=100*colMeans(synergy_matrix > cutoff, na.rm=TRUE),
    no_synergy=100*colMeans(
      synergy_matrix >= -cutoff & synergy_matrix <= cutoff,
      na.rm=TRUE
    ),
    negative=100*colMeans(synergy_matrix < -cutoff, na.rm=TRUE)
  )
}

draw_synergy_percent_plot <- function(percent_df, cutoff) {
  positive_line <- percent_df$positive/100
  positive_no_line <- (percent_df$positive + percent_df$no_synergy)/100
  all_cre_line <- rep(1, nrow(percent_df))
  old_mar <- par("mar")
  on.exit(par(mar=old_mar), add=TRUE)
  par(mar=old_mar+c(0,0,0,4))

  plot(percent_df$fh_conc, positive_line,
       log="x", type="n", axes=FALSE, ann=FALSE,
       xlim=c(fh_conc_plot_min,fh_conc_plot_max), ylim=c(0,1))
  polygon(c(percent_df$fh_conc,rev(percent_df$fh_conc)),
          c(rep(0,nrow(percent_df)),rev(positive_line)),
          col=synergy_band_cols["positive"],border=NA)
  polygon(c(percent_df$fh_conc,rev(percent_df$fh_conc)),
          c(positive_line,rev(positive_no_line)),
          col=synergy_band_cols["no_synergy"],border=NA)
  polygon(c(percent_df$fh_conc,rev(percent_df$fh_conc)),
          c(positive_no_line,rev(all_cre_line)),
          col=synergy_band_cols["negative"],border=NA)
  axis(1,at=fh_diag_axis_at,labels=fh_diag_f_labels,lwd=1,tck=-0.02,
       col=rgb(0,0,0,0),col.ticks="black",padj=-2,cex.axis=0.8)
  axis(3,at=fh_diag_axis_at,labels=fh_diag_h_labels,lwd=1,tck=-0.02,
       col=rgb(0,0,0,0),col.ticks="black",padj=1.78,cex.axis=0.8)
  axis(2,at=c(0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1),labels=c(0,25,50,75,100),
       lwd=1,tck=-0.02,col=rgb(0,0,0,0),col.ticks="black",
       padj=1.4,cex.axis=0.8)
  title(xlab="[FOXA1] (nM)",ylab="CREs (%)",line=1.5,cex.lab=1)
  box()
  lines(percent_df$fh_conc,positive_line,col=synergy_col,lwd=1.5)
  lines(percent_df$fh_conc,positive_no_line,col="gray35",lwd=1.5)
  lines(percent_df$fh_conc,all_cre_line,col="#C5A83E",lwd=1.5)
  legend("topright",inset=c(-0.58,0),xpd=NA,
         legend=c("Positive synergy","No synergy","Negative synergy"),
         title=paste0("Cutoff = +/-",signif(cutoff,3)),
         fill=synergy_band_cols,border=NA,bty="n",cex=0.65)
}

synergy_cutoff_1 <- 1
synergy_percent_by_conc <- calculate_synergy_percent_by_conc(
  synergy_by_conc, synergy_cutoff_1
)

synergy_category_percent <- function(values, cutoff) {
  values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  c(
    positive_percent=100*mean(values > cutoff),
    no_synergy_percent=100*mean(values >= -cutoff & values <= cutoff),
    negative_percent=100*mean(values < -cutoff),
    n=length(values)
  )
}
synergy_summary_values <- k4fh_over_single_max_conc[final_smallError,,drop=FALSE]
synergy_percent_summary <- rbind(
  HepG2_synergy=synergy_category_percent(
    synergy_summary_values$hepG2_synergy, synergy_cutoff_1
  ),
  max_synergy=synergy_category_percent(
    synergy_summary_values$max_dual_over_single, synergy_cutoff_1
  ),
  regP_synergy=synergy_category_percent(
    synergy_summary_values$synergy, synergy_cutoff_1
  )
)
print(round(synergy_percent_summary,2))
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=2.8, fig.height=3.3,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show'}
log_axis_ticks <- function(lims, base_ticks=c(1,2,5)) {
  ticks <- as.vector(outer(base_ticks, 10^(floor(log10(lims[1])):ceiling(log10(lims[2])))))
  ticks <- sort(unique(ticks[ticks >= lims[1] & ticks <= lims[2]]))
  labels <- format(signif(ticks, 3), scientific=FALSE, trim=TRUE)
  list(at=ticks, labels=labels)
}
```

```{r, eval=T, fig.width=2.8, fig.height=3.3, echo=F, warning=F, results='show'}
peak_group_zero_wilcox_p <- function(values, groups) {
  vapply(levels(groups), function(group_name) {
    group_values <- values[
      is.finite(values) & !is.na(groups) & groups == group_name
    ]
    if (length(group_values) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    suppressWarnings(
      wilcox.test(
        group_values, mu=0, alternative="two.sided", exact=FALSE
      )$p.value
    )
  }, numeric(1))
}
add_peak_group_zero_p_labels <- function(
  values, groups, at=seq_along(levels(groups))
) {
  p_values <- peak_group_zero_wilcox_p(values, groups)
  p_labels <- ifelse(
    is.na(p_values),
    "p = NA",
    paste0("p = ", format.pval(p_values, digits=2, eps=1e-4))
  )
  mtext(
    p_labels, side=3, line=0.25, at=at, cex=0.65
  )
}
```

### dist violin

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=1, fig.height=2,  echo=F, dpi=300, warning=F, results='show'}


f_col <- "#E86F77"
h_col <- "#4192D9"
fh_col <- "#9075ab"


### violin plot
my_violin <- function(x,groupname,colors,ylab,ylim=c(5,160),breaks=c(10,100)){
  n <- length(final_smallError)
df <- data.frame(
  group = rep(groupname, each=n),
  value = c(x)
)
df$group <- factor(df$group, levels = groupname)
names(colors) <- groupname
result <- ggplot(df, aes(x=group, y=value, fill=group)) +
  geom_violin() +
    geom_boxplot(trim=FALSE,width = 0.1,fill="white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=colors)+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
  axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
  axis.text.y.right  = element_text(angle = 270, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
  axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "pt") ,
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  plot.title = element_text(size = 5), axis.ticks.y.right = element_line(),
  #axis.title.y = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
  panel.background = element_blank() 
  )+labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,title = ylab,
  )+coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim)
 # axis.ticks = element_blank
return(result)
  }

f_range <- c(7,160)
my_violin(c(gHill_par_foxa1_k1f[final_smallError,]$Kd),groupname = c("F"),colors=c(f_col),"FOXA1",f_range,c(10,30,100))+scale_y_log10(breaks=c(10,30,100))
my_violin(c(gHill_par_foxa1_k3h[final_smallError,]$Kd),groupname = c("H"),colors=c(h_col),"HNF4A",f_range*0.467,c(5,15,50))+scale_y_log10(breaks=c(5,15,50))
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3.5, fig.height=3.5,  echo=F, dpi=300, warning=F, results='show'}
my_scatter_cor <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  ggplot(data = data, mapping = mapping) +scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(0,5,10))+scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(0,5,10))+
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
    geom_segment(
      x = 0, y = 0, xend = 13, yend = 13,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3
    )+
  stat_cor(
    method = "pearson",
    aes(label = after_stat(rr.label)),
    r.accuracy = 0.01,
    p.accuracy = NULL
  )+  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(0,13), ylim = c(0,13),
    expand = FALSE, clip = "on"
  ) 
   # ggally_cor(data = data,mapping = mapping, size = 3)   # requires ggpubr
}

ggpairs(
  abasal_3lines,
  lower = list(continuous = my_scatter_cor),
  upper = list(continuous = "blank"),
  diag  = list(continuous = "blank"))
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3.2, fig.height=2,  echo=F,  warning=F, results='show',dpi=300}
ggdist_plot <- function(df,groupname,colors,slab_linewidth=0){names(colors) <- groupname
df$group <- factor(df$group, levels = groupname)
result <- ggplot(df, aes(x=value, y=group, fill=group)) + 
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray20",
    linewidth = 0.25
  )+
    stat_halfeye(adjust = 1.5,justification = 0,width = 1, slab_linewidth = slab_linewidth, slab_color="black",
    .width = 0,side="right",point_size = 0) +
 # geom_violin(adjust = 2,trim=TRUE) +
    geom_boxplot(trim=FALSE,width = 0.17,fill="white",outlier.size = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=colors)+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
  #axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
  #axis.text.y.right  = element_text(angle = 270, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
  axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "pt") ,
  axis.title.x = element_text(size=10),
  plot.title = element_text(size = 0), axis.ticks.y.right = element_line(),
  axis.title.y = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
  panel.background = element_blank() 
  )+labs(
    x = "Synergy Score",
    y = NULL,title = NULL,
  )
#+coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim)
return(result)}

ggdist_plot(df,groupname,colors)
```

```{r ,  eval=F,fig.width=3.9, fig.height=3.,  echo=F,  warning=F, results='show',dpi=300}
par(
  mfrow = c(5,1),
  mar = c(0,2,0,0),   # remove margins inside panels

smooth_hist <- function(x,col="gray",aty=c(0,500)){
  dens <- density(x)
  h <- hist(x, probability = TRUE, col = "white", main = "",xlim=c(-1.6,5.5),border="white",ylim=c(0,300),axes=FALSE,ann=FALSE,plot = FALSE) #ylim=c(0,max(counts)*1.5)
  bw <- diff(h$breaks)[1]
  counts <- dens$y * length(x)* bw
  hist(x, probability = TRUE, col = "white", main = "",xlim=c(-1.6,5.5),border="white",ylim=c(0,max(counts)*1.5),axes=FALSE,ann=FALSE)
  box()
  axis(2, at = aty,   lwd = 1, tck = -0.035, col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks = "black", padj=1.3, cex.axis=1)
  axis(1, at = c(-1,0,1,2,3,4,5), lwd = 1, tck = -0.035, col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks = "black", padj=-1.3, cex.axis=1)
```

```{r ,  eval=F,fig.width=3.6, fig.height=4.,  echo=F,  warning=F, results='show'}
synergy_aff <- gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[final_smallError,"hepG2_synergy",drop=F]

synergy_aff$half <- with(synergy_aff, ave(hepG2_synergy, rep(1, nrow(synergy_aff)),FUN = function(x) {
  q30 <- quantile(x, 3/10, na.rm = TRUE)
  q70 <- quantile(x, 7/10, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  ifelse(x >= q70, "top",
         ifelse(x <= q30, "bottom", "middle"))
}))
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=1.7, fig.height=5.88,  echo=F,  warning=F, results='show',dpi=300}
tfbsn_groups <- function(data_, group,logy="",ylab_="",linesadd=FALSE,base_col = "#9075ab",yat=c(0,1,2,3),ylabel=NA,labeln=F,xlabel=F){#"#E86F77"
  test <- cor.test(data_[[group]], data_$fn,method = "spearman")
  n <- length(unique(data_$fn))
  med <- tapply(data_[[group]], data_$fn, mean)
  se <- tapply(data_[[group]], data_$fn, function(x) 1.96*sd(x)/sqrt(length(x))) ### 1.96SE is 95% CI
  y_min <- min(c(med,med - se),na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(c(med,med + se),na.rm = TRUE)
  pad <- 0.05 * (y_max - y_min)
  grad <- (colorRampPalette(c("white", base_col))(n))
  bp <- boxplot(as.formula(paste(group, "~ fn")) , data = data_,log=logy,col = grad,axes = FALSE, ann = FALSE,lwd = 0.75,medlwd = 0.8,at=sort(unique(data_$fn)),outcex=0.75)
  if(all(is.na(ylabel))){
  axis(2, at = yat,   lwd = 1, tck = -0.025, col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks = "black", padj=1.5, cex.axis=0.8)
  }else{
      axis(2, at = yat,labels = ylabel,   lwd = 1, tck = -0.025, col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks = "black", padj=1.5, cex.axis=0.8)
  }
if(xlabel){  axis(1, at = c(0,1,2,3,4,5,6), lwd = 1, tck = -0.025, col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks = "black", padj=-1.9, cex.axis=0.8)
}    
  title(
    ylab=ylab_,
    xlab=if (xlabel) "Number of TF sites" else "",
    line=1.,
    cex.lab=0.8
  )
  box()
if(labeln){  n <- table(data_$fn)
text(x = seq_along(bp$names)-1,
     y = bp$stats[5, ],   # top whisker
     labels = paste0("n=", n[bp$names]),
     pos = 3,cex=0.8)
}  #main=paste("p=",test$p.value,"\nrho=",as.numeric(test$estimate),sep = "")
  names <- row.names(data_)

# x positions and medians
if(logy=="y"){
  x <- as.numeric(bp$names)
y <- log(bp$stats[3, ])
fit <- lm(y ~ x)
x_full <- seq(min(x), max(x), length.out = 100)
y_full <- exp(predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x_full)))
}else{x <- as.numeric(bp$names)
y <- bp$stats[3, ]
fit <- lm(y ~ x)

}
    lines(x_full, y_full, col = alpha("white",0.5), lwd = 2)
  lines(x_full, y_full, col = "gray50", lwd = 1,lty=5)

  if(linesadd){
    grep("aff_chr2_231915124_231915324_FH2.2",names)
    for (i in c(1:5)) {
      lines(c(1,2),c(data_[paste0("aff_chr2_231915124_231915324_FH1",i,"5"),group],data_[paste0("aff_chr2_231915124_231915324_FH2",i,"2"),group]),lwd=0.5)
      lines(c(1,2),c(data_[paste0("aff_chr2_231915124_231915324_FH5",i,"1"),group],data_[paste0("aff_chr2_231915124_231915324_FH2",i,"2"),group]),lwd=0.5)
    }
  }
  if(test$p.value>0.1){
    p_text <- paste0("p = ", signif(test$p.value, 3))
  }else{
    p_text <- paste0("p = ", formatC(test$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2))
  }
  
  #p_text <- paste0("p = ", formatC(pval, format = "e", digits = 2))
  x_range <- range(data_$fn)
  y_range <- range(data_[[group]], na.rm = TRUE)

  x_pos <- x_range[2] - 0.5 * diff(x_range)
  y_pos <- y_range[1] + 0.2 * diff(y_range)
#  text(x_pos, y_pos, labels = p_text, pos = 1, cex = 1.)
  #mtext(p_text, side = 3, line = 0.5)

}
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3.6, fig.height=4,  echo=F,  warning=F, results='show',dpi=300}
hnf4a_score_perPos_rc <- read.table("~/mnt/scratch/sequencing/perpos_prob/rc_hnf4a_prob_nt30_v8v_v8_1e3_0725.txt" ,row.names = 1)
hnf4a_score_perPos_bothO <- hnf4a_score_perPos+hnf4a_score_perPos_rc
hnf4a_max_score <- apply(hnf4a_score_perPos_bothO, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)
hnf4a_max_score_f <- apply(hnf4a_score_perPos, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)

```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3.6, fig.height=2.3,  echo=F,  warning=F, results='show',dpi=300}
library(ggbreak)

#bc_full_list <- row.names(hnf4a_score_perPos_bothO)
aff_cutoff<- 0.5
step=15
all_tag  <-final_smallError
#all_tag <- c("L1_8highH")


### add orientation

df_foranova <- data.frame(y=rep(NA,length(all_tag)),
                            x1=log(kd_score_F_table[all_tag,]$kas*kd_score_H_table[all_tag,]$kas),
                            x2=rep("0",length(all_tag)),  # number of F + H BS
                            x3=rep("1000",length(all_tag)),  # F pos
                            x4=rep("1000",length(all_tag)),  # H pos
                            x5=rep("1000",length(all_tag)),  # F-H distance
                            x6=rep("0",length(all_tag)),  # other TF number
                            x7=rep("no",length(all_tag)),  # F orientation
                            x8=rep("no",length(all_tag)),  # H orientation
                            row.names = all_tag)
  
for (i in all_tag) {
  df_foranova[i,]$x6 <- as.character(round(TF_number[i,]/1,0))
  #df_foranova$x6[is.na(df_foranova$x6)] <- 0
  
  df_foranova[i,]$x2 <- as.character(lib1_tfbsn[i,]$f+lib1_tfbsn[i,]$h) #as.character(length(which(round(hnf4a_score_perPos_bothO[i,],1)>aff_cutoff )) + length(which(round(foxa1_score_perPos_bothO[i,],1)>aff_cutoff )))
  max_h <-  which.max(hnf4a_score_perPos_bothO[i,])
  max_f <-  which.max(foxa1_score_perPos_bothO[i,])
  max_h_aff <- round(hnf4a_score_perPos_bothO[i,max_h],1)
  max_f_aff <- round(foxa1_score_perPos_bothO[i,max_f],1)
  #fh_pos <- c(max_f,max_h)[which.max(c(foxa1_score_perPos_bothO[i,max_f],hnf4a_score_perPos_bothO[i,max_h]))]
  if(max_h_aff>=aff_cutoff ){
    df_foranova[i,]$x4 <-  as.character(round(max_h/step,0))
    if(hnf4a_max_score_f[i]>hnf4a_max_score_r[i]){
      df_foranova[i,]$x8 <- "F"
    }else{
      df_foranova[i,]$x8 <- "R"
    }
  }
  if(max_f_aff>=aff_cutoff ){
    df_foranova[i,]$x3 <-  as.character(round(max_f/step,0))
    if(foxa1_max_score_f[i]>foxa1_max_score_r[i]){
      df_foranova[i,]$x7 <- "F"
    }else{
      df_foranova[i,]$x7 <- "R"
    }
  }

  if(max_h_aff>=aff_cutoff && max_f_aff>=aff_cutoff){
    dist <- (max_h-max_f)
    df_foranova[i,]$x5 <- as.character(round(dist/step,0))
  }
}
df_foranova$x6[is.na(df_foranova$x6)] <- "0"
#df_foranova <- df_foranova %>% mutate(across(c("x2","x3","x4","x5","x6"), as.numeric))

  run_anova <- function(yy,mytitle=""){
df_foranova$y <- yy
model <- aov(y ~ x1 + x2 + x3+x4+x5+x6+x7+x8, data = df_foranova,na.action = na.omit)
#model <- aov(y ~ x1 + x2 + x3+x4+x6, data = df_foranova)

# ANOVA table
anova_out <- anova(model)
ss_total <- sum(anova_out$"Sum Sq")

# Add % variance explained column
anova_out$Percent <- (anova_out$"Sum Sq" / ss_total) * 100
print(anova_out)
names <-   c("deltaG", "# of BS", "F pos", "H pos", "F-H distance","# of other TFBS","F orientation","H orientation","residuals")
df_plot <- data.frame(
  term = c("deltaG", "# of BS", "F pos", "H pos", "F-H distance","# of other TFBS","F orientation","H orientation","residuals"),
  pct  = anova_out$Percent,
  pval = anova_out$`Pr(>F)`
)

barorder <- c("deltaG","# of BS","# of other TFBS","F-H distance","F pos","H pos","F orientation","H orientation","residuals")
df_plot$stars <- cut(df_plot$pval,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf),
  labels = c("***","**","*","")
)
df_plot$term <- factor(names, levels = barorder)
colors <- setNames(c(scales::hue_pal()(8),"#F4F6F8"), barorder)

ggplot(df_plot, aes(term, pct, fill = term)) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  geom_text(aes(label = stars), vjust = -1.2) +
  geom_text(
    aes(y = pct, label = paste0(round(pct,0), "%")),
    vjust = -0.2,
    size = 3.5
  )+
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",axis.line = element_blank(),axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))+
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)) +labs(title = mytitle,ylab="% Variance")
  #scale_y_break(c(30, max(df_plot$pct)-5)) 
}


run_anova(gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[all_tag,]$regP,"regP")
run_anova(gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[all_tag,]$hepG2_synergy,"hepG2_synergy")
run_anova(gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[all_tag,]$basal,"Abasal")
run_anova(gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[all_tag,]$Kd,"EC50")
run_anova(gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[all_tag,]$n,"n_H")
```
